data.title: 朝田诗乃 · 静音礼堂里的蓝色花嫁
data.description: 【郊外小教堂·清晨】诗乃穿着剪裁简洁的蓝白婚纱站在钢琴旁，黑框眼镜被换成细小的银色发饰；她指尖轻触捧花上的蓝色小花，面对镜头时的安静笑容像一段终于完成的旋律。
data.location: small countryside chapel with an upright piano
data.action: 钢琴旁整理银色发饰并轻触蓝花捧花，安静回眸微笑
data.lighting: clear morning light and pale blue window glow
data.mood: 现实世界里的安静誓约
data.promptProse: Beside the small chapel piano, Shino Asada touches a blue flower in her bouquet and turns toward the viewer with a quiet smile. Her simple blue-and-white wedding gown, veil and silver hair ornament frame ash-brown hair without glasses. The vertical medium-full composition includes the piano side and pale window behind. Clear morning light illuminates her fingers and gown folds, while faint blue window reflection lies across the piano's polished lid.
